title: A squirrel at 12:30
instructions: Try spotting a squirrel at 12:30 pm. Photograph it from a distance without feeding or approaching it. This timed challenge needs an admin review; the photo itself does not prove the time.
proof: A squirrel visible outdoors. Do not infer a capture time from the photo or its text. An admin must decide whether there is enough evidence for this timed challenge.

title: Find a squirrel in a tree
instructions: Look for a squirrel sitting in a tree and take a photo from a public path. Do not approach, feed, chase, touch, or lure wildlife.
proof: A squirrel clearly visible sitting on a tree trunk or branch outdoors.

title: Two squirrels, one frame
instructions: Photograph two squirrels together in one frame from a respectful distance. Let them come together naturally; no feeding, chasing, touching, or arranging the animals.
proof: At least two distinct squirrels clearly visible together in one unedited outdoor photo, not a collage.

title: Try a campus snack
instructions: Choose a snack and photograph it. A snack you already have is fine; no purchase is required. Be courteous to staff and keep strangers and payment details out of the photo.
proof: A recognizable snack or prepared food item clearly visible in a single photo. Do not infer where or how it was obtained.

title: Five friendly hellos
instructions: Say hello to five willing people. Handshakes are optional; respect anyone who declines. Submit a photo only with participants' permission. An admin reviews this challenge because a single photo cannot prove five separate greetings.
proof: A consensual group or greeting photo. Do not infer five interactions, stranger status, consent, or identities from appearances. An admin must review the claimed activity.

title: Campus bathrobe style
instructions: Take a playful photo wearing a bathrobe over normal clothing in a permitted campus space. Joining class in it is optional and subject to the instructor's rules. Avoid disrupting classes or photographing bystanders.
proof: A person visibly wearing a bathrobe over normal clothing. A photo cannot prove class attendance or permission; an admin reviews the evidence.

title: A movement break on the Quad
instructions: Take a gentle stretch or movement break on an open grassy area. Skip somersaults or any movement that feels unsafe. Submit a photo with participants' permission; no athletic ability is required.
proof: A person visibly stretching or taking a movement break on grass. Do not infer a sequence, number of repetitions, or exact campus location. An admin reviews this activity.
